# Elgato Control Center sub-actions

## Get Light Info

Reads a light's current settings into variables you can use in later steps.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Device** | Which light to change: its name, serial number or network address (IP), like "Key Light Left". Separate several with commas. All (the default) means every light. Starts as: `All`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%elgatoLightCount%` | How many lights were changed |
| `%deviceName%` | The name of the first light changed |
| `%deviceId%` | Its serial number |
| `%powerState%` | On or Off, after the change |
| `%brightness%` | Its brightness after the change (0-100) |
| `%temperature%` | Its color warmth after the change, in Kelvin |
| `%hue%` | Its color position (0-360), if it is a color light |
| `%saturation%` | Its color strength (0-100), if it is a color light |
| `%ipAddress%` | Its address on your network |
| `%productName%` | The kind of light, like Key Light |
| `%serialNumber%` | The light's serial number |
| `%firmwareVersion%` | The light's software version |
| `%online%` | true if the light is answering |

<small>Type id: `elgato.controlCenter.getDevice`</small>

## Make Light Blink

Makes your Elgato light blink for a moment so you can see which one it is.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Device** | Which light to change: its name, serial number or network address (IP), like "Key Light Left". Separate several with commas. All (the default) means every light. Starts as: `All`. |

<small>Type id: `elgato.controlCenter.identify`</small>

## Set Brightness

Changes how bright your Elgato light is.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Device** | Which light to change: its name, serial number or network address (IP), like "Key Light Left". Separate several with commas. All (the default) means every light. Starts as: `All`. |
| **Brightness (0-100 %)** | How bright, from 0 to 100. With Adjustment ticked, how much to add or take away. Starts as: `50`. |
| **Add to current value** | Tick to add your number to the current setting instead of replacing it. Use a negative number to go down, like -10. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%elgatoLightCount%` | How many lights were changed |
| `%deviceName%` | The name of the first light changed |
| `%deviceId%` | Its serial number |
| `%powerState%` | On or Off, after the change |
| `%brightness%` | Its brightness after the change (0-100) |
| `%temperature%` | Its color warmth after the change, in Kelvin |
| `%hue%` | Its color position (0-360), if it is a color light |
| `%saturation%` | Its color strength (0-100), if it is a color light |
| `%ipAddress%` | Its address on your network |

<small>Type id: `elgato.controlCenter.setBrightness`</small>

## Set Color (Light Strip)

Sets the color of a color light, like the Elgato Light Strip. Plain white lights such as the Key Light have no color.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Device** | Which light to change: its name, serial number or network address (IP), like "Key Light Left". Separate several with commas. All (the default) means every light. Starts as: `All`. |
| **Hue (0-360)** | The color, from 0 to 360 around the color wheel: 0 is red, 120 is green, 240 is blue. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Saturation (0-100)** | How strong the color is, from 0 (white) to 100 (full color). Starts as: `100`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%elgatoLightCount%` | How many lights were changed |
| `%deviceName%` | The name of the first light changed |
| `%deviceId%` | Its serial number |
| `%powerState%` | On or Off, after the change |
| `%brightness%` | Its brightness after the change (0-100) |
| `%temperature%` | Its color warmth after the change, in Kelvin |
| `%hue%` | Its color position (0-360), if it is a color light |
| `%saturation%` | Its color strength (0-100), if it is a color light |
| `%ipAddress%` | Its address on your network |

<small>Type id: `elgato.controlCenter.setColor`</small>

## Set Colour Warmth

Changes how warm (orange) or cool (blue) the white light is.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Device** | Which light to change: its name, serial number or network address (IP), like "Key Light Left". Separate several with commas. All (the default) means every light. Starts as: `All`. |
| **Temperature (K)** | Color warmth in Kelvin, from 2900 (warm, orange) to 7000 (cool, blue). With Adjustment ticked, how many Kelvin to add or take away. Starts as: `4500`. |
| **Add to current value** | Tick to add your number to the current setting instead of replacing it. Use a negative number to go down, like -10. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%elgatoLightCount%` | How many lights were changed |
| `%deviceName%` | The name of the first light changed |
| `%deviceId%` | Its serial number |
| `%powerState%` | On or Off, after the change |
| `%brightness%` | Its brightness after the change (0-100) |
| `%temperature%` | Its color warmth after the change, in Kelvin |
| `%hue%` | Its color position (0-360), if it is a color light |
| `%saturation%` | Its color strength (0-100), if it is a color light |
| `%ipAddress%` | Its address on your network |

<small>Type id: `elgato.controlCenter.setTemperature`</small>

## Set Power State

Turns your Elgato light on or off.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Device** | Which light to change: its name, serial number or network address (IP), like "Key Light Left". Separate several with commas. All (the default) means every light. Starts as: `All`. |
| **State** | On turns the light on, Off turns it off, Toggle flips it to the opposite of what it is now. Options: Off, On, Toggle. Starts as: `Toggle`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%elgatoLightCount%` | How many lights were changed |
| `%deviceName%` | The name of the first light changed |
| `%deviceId%` | Its serial number |
| `%powerState%` | On or Off, after the change |
| `%brightness%` | Its brightness after the change (0-100) |
| `%temperature%` | Its color warmth after the change, in Kelvin |
| `%hue%` | Its color position (0-360), if it is a color light |
| `%saturation%` | Its color strength (0-100), if it is a color light |
| `%ipAddress%` | Its address on your network |

<small>Type id: `elgato.controlCenter.setPowerState`</small>
